post.originalText:
Asked Fable 5.2 to create a realistic GPU sandbox to simulate element interaction and it one-shotted it to create a fun simulation box:
Currently I have added Boids (for simulating birds), various elements and electronics!  
I wonder if I can create a simple computer within it!
